bio: I'm a DevOps engineer passionate about building efficient and secure cloud-native systems. I focus on automation, I craft scalable workflows that empower teams and deliver value.

services.text: Implementing AI & ML solutions to enhance efficiency and smart infrastructure.

services.text: Teaching Python, DevOps best-practices, and cloud fundamentals to beginners.

experience.title: Engineer III
experience.description: I designed and implemented infrastructure as code using Terraform and built CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline. I deployed scalable applications with Docker and orchestrated data workflows using AWS Glue, managing services like S3, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, ECR, DMS, Athena, and Lake Formation. I developed Python-based data pipelines and implemented Great Expectations with AWS Airflow to ensure data quality. I led migrations of databases and files to S3 for cost optimization, leveraged Athena and Lake Formation for data governance, and created a UI for managing data archives. Additionally, I set up AWS Transfer Family with SSO for secure access and built AI-powered solutions using Flask, refine.dev, Ollama, Azure AI, and Amazon Bedrock for Alation.

experience.title: IS System Analyst
experience.description: I performed Punch-out mapping and organization setup, resolved customer order issues including stuck transmissions, and maintained user and banner configurations. I collaborated with product owners, completed Jira sprint tasks, and supported both B2B and B2C systems. I conducted load testing to ensure performance and utilized the ELK Stack for centralized logging and monitoring. Additionally, I deployed and managed applications using Kubernetes for improved scalability and reliability.
